settings.name: JDT.LS Home
settings.description: Absolute path to your Eclipse JDT.LS installation directory (e.g., /opt/jdtls).

settings.name: Java Home
settings.description: Absolute path to the JDK used to verify and launch JDT.LS (overrides system JAVA_HOME).

settings.name: Java Workspace Path
settings.description: Default root path for Java workspace (default: current working directory).

settings.name: Java Runtimes
settings.description: JSON array of Java runtimes for different Java versions (e.g., [{"name": "JavaSE-17", "path": "/path/to/jdk-17"}]).

settings.name: Maven User Settings
settings.description: Path to custom Maven user settings.xml.

settings.name: Maven Global Settings
settings.description: Path to custom Maven global settings.xml.

settings.name: Maven Offline Mode
settings.description: Whether to enable Maven offline mode ('true' or 'false').
